name: PassengerSelector
description: Passenger counters per age band plus cabin choice, inside the search widget.

evidence: Props and composition documented; states and accessibility come from Counter and Overlay.

provenance.tag: A · unverified (counter with +/−, three passenger categories); four cabins: Official

props.name: ageBands
props.description: From config. The sources conflict on child age (File A 2–11, Official seat rule 2–12). Do not hardcode.

props.name: cabin
props.description: Official: four cabins. File A omits Premium Economy.

source.tag: A · unverified ("in seat or on lap")

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Dispatches REMOVE_PASSENGER. Removes the most recently added passenger of that type, so earlier passengers keep their ids and seats.

rules: Passenger counts change through add and remove, never by setting a count (rebuilding the array would give everyone new ids and drop their seats).

ambiguities.description: Child age band: File A says 2–11, the Official seat-fee rule says 2–12. Must come from config.
Cabin uses "SegmentedControl or Combobox"; the choice is not decided.
The popover/sheet breakpoints are given as lg+ and sm; md is not stated.
